[1]
answer: Spread Syntax - Concatenation Logic - Concatenate using `[...nums, ...nums]`. - `return [...nums, ...nums];` Use spread syntax to duplicate and concatenate `nums`.

1512. Number of Good Pairs - Count pairs with matching values at different indices - [1,2,3,1,1,3] => 4 - Identify pairs in an array where two elements are equal and occur at different indices. -
[1]
answer: Hash Map & Iteration - Pair Counting Method - Count with a map tracking occurrences. - `let count = 0; for (const number of nums) { if (map[number]) { count += map[number]; map[number] += 1; } else { map[number] = 1; } } return count;` Count pairs using a hash map for frequencies.

1637. Widest Vertical Area Between Points - Find largest x-coordinate gap between points - [[8,7],[9,9],[7,4],[9,7]] => 1 - Determine the widest vertical space between points on a plane, based on x-coordinates. -
[1]
answer: Sort and Calculate Gap - Max Width Calculation - Sort points by x-coordinate and find the max gap. - `points.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]); let max = 0; for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) { max = Math.max(max, points[i+1][0] - points[i][0]); } return max;` Sort points by x-coordinate and calculate the largest gap.

2011. Final Value of Variable After Operations - Determine final value of X after increment/decrement operations - ["--X","X++","X++"] => 1 - Calculate the final value of a variable after a series of increment and decrement commands. -
[1]
answer: Reduce Function - Increment/Decrement Processing - Process operations array with `reduce()`. - `return operations.reduce((acc, curr) => curr[1] === "+" ? ++acc : --acc, 0);` Use `reduce()` to iterate over operations, modifying the value of `X` accordingly.
